== Title ==
<span lang="ja">まだ戻ってこない</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">コントロール・フェイズ中、自分の外部惑星位置カード（ドックを除く）上に単独でいるキャラクターを１体目標にする。デスティニーを引く。デスティニー＋３＞能力なら、目標は行方不明になる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「レイア姫はルーク様のことを心配している...彼がどこにいるのかわからないんだ」「僕にもわからないよ」「誰も知らないんだ」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[He Hasn't Come Back Yet]].

'''Lore''' — Princess Leia is worrying about Master Luke. She does not know where he is. I do not know either. Nobody knows.

'''Game text''' — During the control phase, target any character alone at one of your exterior planet location cards except a dock. Draw destiny. The target becomes missing if destiny plus 3 is greater than ability.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese face uses 位置カード for site and ドック for docking bay. It does not print your on the control phase.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-hehasntcomebackyet.gif|Original English face]], [[He Hasn't Come Back Yet]].</ref>
